name: Oven-Baked Salmon Royale
brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder · Triton's / Disney Magic · Lumiere's
whyItWorks: Oven-baked Atlantic salmon and silky truffled cauliflower purée flake and dissolve effortlessly with high anti-inflammatory omega-3s.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask your server to bake the salmon without the horseradish crust if flaring, enjoy the smooth cauliflower purée (or swap for mashed potatoes/white rice), and skip the sautéed Swiss chard leaves.
watchOuts: Horseradish crust if stomach is sensitive
Butter/cream in beurre blanc if lactose sensitive
